documents.err_schedule_fields_removed.en: Celerp no longer keeps {fields}: an agreement bills from its start date, and its periods name the documents it billed.

documents.err_schedule_fields_owned.en: Only an agreement's own schedule actions can set {fields}.

subscriptions.err_agreement_status_elsew.en: An agreement that bills or sends on its own changes status only on its own page: activate, pause, resume or cancel it there.
